title: Game over?
prompt: The game is over when the player has no lives left or the time has run out (zero or less). Return true if it is over.
signature: func solve(lives: int, time_left: float) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(lives: int, time_left: float) -> bool:
	return false
hint: Two ways to lose, joined by or.
solution:
func solve(lives: int, time_left: float) -> bool:
	return lives <= 0 or time_left <= 0
